question: What yogic power and divine equivalence are attained instantly by the practitioner?
premises: The practitioner becomes a yogin equal to Mahādeva.
The practitioner can paralyze the three worlds.
This power is attained in an instant.
inference: The practitioner instantly becomes a Mahādeva-like yogin capable of paralyzing the three worlds.
plain_english: He becomes a yogin equal to Mahādeva, able to paralyze the three worlds in an instant.
